samuel2.7.p1.b1.text: After the king had settled into his palace and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies around him,

samuel2.7.p1.b2.text: Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.

samuel2.7.p1.b3.text: Go and do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.

samuel2.7.p2.b1.text: But that night the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying,

samuel2.7.p2.b2.text: “Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build for Me a house to dwell in?

samuel2.7.p2.b3.text: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved about with a tent as My dwelling.

samuel2.7.p3.b1.text: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.

samuel2.7.p3.b2.text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you.

samuel2.7.p3.b3.text: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more.

samuel2.7.p3.b4.text: The LORD declares to you that He Himself will establish a house for you.

samuel2.7.p4.b1.text: And when your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body, and I will establish his kingdom.

samuel2.7.p4.b2.text: He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

samuel2.7.p4.b3.text: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. … But My loving devotion will never be removed from him …

samuel2.7.p4.b4.text: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.”

samuel2.7.p5.b1.text: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire vision.

samuel2.7.p5.b2.text: Who am I, O Lord GOD, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?

samuel2.7.p5.b3.text: What more can David say to You? For You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.

samuel2.7.p6.b1.text: How great You are, O Lord GOD! For there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.

samuel2.7.p6.b2.text: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself … whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.

samuel2.7.p6.b3.text: For You have established Your people Israel as Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.

samuel2.7.p7.b1.text: And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,

samuel2.7.p7.b2.text: So that Your name will be magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel.’

samuel2.7.p7.b3.text: For You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant when You said, ‘I will build a house for you.’ Therefore Your servant has found the courage to offer this prayer to You.

samuel2.7.p8.b1.text: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true,

samuel2.7.p8.b2.text: Now therefore, may it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You.

samuel2.7.p8.b3.text: For You, O Lord GOD, have spoken, and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever.
